ST-13 STARTING STARTER
REASSEMBLY
HINT:
Use high-temperature grease to lubricate the bearings and
gears when assembling the starter.
1. INSTALL ARMATURE TO MAGNETIC SWITCH ASv
$EMBLY
(a) 2ZZ-GE:
Rotating the ring of the front bearing, set it properly so that
y the projection of the ring is positioned in the narrowest
part.
(b) Apply grease to the armature bearings.
(c) 122-FE:
Install the armature to the magnetic switch assembly.
(d) 2ZZ-GE:
Using a press, install the armature to the magnetic switch
assembly.
2. INSERT STEEL BALL INTO CLUTCH SHAFT HOLE
(a) Apply grease to the steel ball.
(b) Insert the steel ball into the clutch shaft hole.

AND GEARS
